nodes.label: D0 No crashes, guaranteed
nodes.rationale: Most important directive; wins every conflict. Safer implementation is chosen over faster or prettier.

nodes.label: D1 Optimization
nodes.rationale: Zero allocations in hot paths to keep multi-player boss fights at a steady 60 FPS.

nodes.label: D2 Co-op compatibility
nodes.rationale: Server decides NPC/world/random outcomes; owner-only player projectiles to avoid desyncs.

nodes.label: D3 Balance
nodes.rationale: Every combat stat anchored to a same-tier vanilla item within +/-15% effective DPS.

nodes.label: D4 Pixel art
nodes.rationale: Vanilla-grade hand pixel art: 1x drawn, 2x nearest-neighbor, locked palette, no mixels.

nodes.label: D5 Visual proof (GIF)
nodes.rationale: Every animated change proven with a GIF from frames or simulation; in-game capture not required.

nodes.label: Core/Safety/SafeSpawn
nodes.rationale: Vanilla NewProjectile overwrites the oldest projectile and NewNPC returns dummy slot 200; SafeSpawn refuses instead and keeps reserve slots.

nodes.label: Core/Safety/SafeLog
nodes.rationale: Reports each key at most 3 times to prevent console loops.

nodes.label: PacketRegistry
nodes.rationale: Catches exceptions and drops bad packets; byte id limit enforced at load.

nodes.label: SafeGenPass
nodes.rationale: Catches exceptions so world creation continues.

nodes.label: Core/Templates bases (CogpunkItem/NPC/Projectile/Tile/Wall/Buff)
nodes.rationale: Missing-texture fallback means missing art never blocks loading.

nodes.label: WorldFlagSystem
nodes.rationale: Saves flags by name, never numeric id, so older worlds load.

nodes.label: Expert-first balance
nodes.rationale: User directive 2026-10-27: Cogpunk is played on Expert; every number is the Expert value, Classic half, Master 1.5x via vanilla ratios.

nodes.label: Boss treasure bags drop only in Expert/Master (ItemDropRule.BossBag)
terraria.wiki.gg
nodes.rationale: Vanilla numbers come from the wiki, never from memory.

nodes.label: Attack-pattern fairness (telegraphs, dodgeable, color-coded)
nodes.rationale: Co-op adds pressure rather than guaranteed deaths; screen readable in a 4-player fight.

nodes.label: 4% base crit rule
nodes.rationale: User rule 2026-10-23: leave Item.crit = 0, Generic supplies 4%.

nodes.label: Seamless blocks (clump look of vanilla ores)
nodes.rationale: Rusted Scrap went from seam ratio 3.25 to 0.71 under this rule.

nodes.label: Multiplane parallax layers (<=3)
nodes.rationale: Never rotate/scale at runtime to avoid mixels; render poses from a generator.

nodes.label: Stable pixels (no colour flicker)
nodes.rationale: User 2026-10-29: Trash-Tr0m rust and Tar Tyrant shading changed colour between frames.

nodes.label: Core/Templates/StateMachineNPC
nodes.rationale: Owns ai[0] state and ai[1] timer, seals AI(), recovers from NaN, ChangeState ignored on clients.

nodes.label: *RigData.cs generated rig tables
nodes.rationale: Generator writes cell sizes, origins and contact points so art and code cannot drift apart.

nodes.label: Clear outdated proofs
nodes.rationale: User 2026-10-28: project size.

nodes.label: Architecture: Core/ engine + Content/<Slice>/
nodes.rationale: Chosen after comparing Calamity (type-based), Starlight River and Spirit Reforged (feature-based); slices must not depend on each other's internals.

nodes.label: ExampleMod branch 1.4.4 reference map
nodes.rationale: DeepWiki indexes the 1.4.5 branch, so cross-check with 1.4.4; never invent APIs.

nodes.label: tModLoader stable 1.4.4 line (.NET 8)
nodes.rationale: 1.4.5 branch is contributors-only/unstable; port later with tModPorter.

nodes.label: Core/Hooks/SceneOverlayRegistry
nodes.rationale: The one reflection touch; isolated for the 1.4.5 port.

nodes.label: SteamPlayer (Steam resource)
nodes.rationale: Steam works like mana (user 2026-10-27), not pressure builds up; base tank 0, only gear grants capacity.

nodes.label: Boss-fight rules (defeat card, no spawns, biome despawn, art hitboxes)
Tar Tyrant boss
nodes.rationale: User exception 2026-10-29: shrinks like King Slime, drawn at scale with point sampling.

nodes.label: Bosses that move a player (conveyor pull)
Core/Events/CogpunkInvasion
nodes.rationale: Re-implements vanilla goblin-army rules line for line.

nodes.label: Junkyard (replaces left beach)
nodes.rationale: Keep vanilla structures out instead of shrinking around them.

nodes.label: Biome liquid as restyled water (ModWaterStyle)
nodes.rationale: No ModLiquid in 1.4.4; Calamity Sulphurous Sea pattern.

hyperedges.label: Detailed-entity art direction (3/4 view, multiplane, death cinematic, Metal Slug detail)
